text:
```yaml
name: Lint

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - 'release-*'
    paths:
      - '**/*.go'
      - go.mod
      - go.sum
      - .golangci.yml
      - .github/workflows/lint.yml

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: 1.17

      - name: Install golangci-lint
        run: |
          wget https://github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/releases/download/v1.64.1/golangci-lint-1.64.1-linux-amd64.tar.gz
          tar -C /usr/local/bin -xzf golangci-lint-1.64.1-linux-amd64.tar.gz
          rm golangci-lint-1.64.1-linux-amd64.tar.gz

      - name: Run golangci-lint
        run: make lint
```
